maxina.title: Maxina Support
maxina.subtitle: How can we help you today?
maxina.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions or contact our support team.

createAccount.question: How do I create a Maxina account?
createAccount.answer: Download the Maxina app or visit our portal at vitanaland.com/maxina. Tap 'Register' and enter your email address. You will receive a confirmation email to verify your account. After confirmation, complete your profile to discover wellness events and community features.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: On the login screen, tap 'Forgot Password' and enter your registered email address. You will receive a password reset link within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if you don't see the email. For security reasons, the link expires after 24 hours.

joinEvents.question: How do I join events and meetups?
joinEvents.answer: Browse available events in the Events & MeetUps section. Tap an event to view details such as date, location, and price. For free events, simply tap 'Participate' or 'RSVP'. For paid events, you can securely purchase tickets through our integrated payment system.

updateProfile.question: How do I update my profile information?
updateProfile.answer: Go to your Profile tab and tap the Edit icon or 'Edit Profile'. You can update your display name, bio, profile picture, and wellness interests. Changes are saved automatically. Your profile helps us personalize event recommendations for you.

deleteAccount.question: How can I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: To delete your Maxina account and associated data, please send an email to support@exafy.io with the subject 'Account Deletion – Maxina'. Provide the email address linked to your account. We process deletion requests within 30 days.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods are accepted?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our secure Stripe payment integration. Apple Pay and Google Pay are also available on supported devices. All transactions are encrypted and PCI-DSS compliant.

contactOrganizers.question: How do I contact event organizers?
contactOrganizers.answer: On each event page, you will find the organizer's profile. Tap the name to view the profile and access messaging options. For questions about specific events, use the event's Q&A section or contact the organizer directly via in-app messaging.

dataSecure.question: Is my personal data secure?
dataSecure.answer: Yes, your privacy and security are our top priority. We use industry-standard encryption, secure authentication, and comply with GDPR guidelines. We never share your personal data with third parties without your consent. Read our full privacy policy for more details.
